description: This file defines the interface IRtspClient for an RTSP client component within the WPEFramework project. It specifies the methods for configuring, controlling playback (setup, play, teardown), and managing properties (set/get) related to RTSP streaming.

classes.name: IRtspClient
classes.description: An interface for RTSP client operations, including configuration, setup, playback control, and property management.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the RTSP client with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Prepares the RTSP client with the specified asset and position.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback at the specified scale and position.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Cleans up and stops the RTSP session.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a property value by name.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by name.
